# Interface: HostedSupervisorTool

Tagged record returned by every [supervisorTools](./docs/api/appkit/Variable.supervisorTools.md) factory. The `__kind` discriminator lets the agents plugin (and standalone `runAgent`) classify these tools without a structural match against the wire format — keeps the SA wire shape free to evolve and avoids namespace collisions with MCP hosted tools (which use `type: "genie-space"` hyphenated, vs SA's `type: "genie_space"` underscored).
